latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of daily-news-collector.

- Automatically collects news from RSS feeds, websites, and APIs.
- Supports data merging, smart filtering, topic classification, and summary generation.
- Produces structured daily reports in Markdown format.
- Includes scripts for feed and webpage data collection.
- Flexible configuration for data sources and output templates.
